card.name: Reference-entry structure points in encyclopedia text
card.fires_on: Structural words in dictionary or encyclopedia-style web entries, such as a colon after a label, a dash before a cross-reference, 'See' before 'also', or 'seat' and 'of' in a descriptive sentence. The setting is non-medical reference text.

modes.label: Entry labels and cross-references
modes.description: A dash, colon or 'See' that introduces a label or a cross-reference at the end of a reference entry.
modes.example: A sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms<< -->> psalm. Compare oide. see

modes.label: Linking words in descriptive facts
modes.description: A noun or 'of' inside a factual sentence about a place, course or species.
modes.example: It is the<< seat>> of Tufts Univ. Several 1

modes.label: Sentence end before a citation
modes.description: A period or bracket closing a title or reference just before a new fragment.

card.plain: It fires on small structural points in encyclopedia-style entries, such as labels, cross-references and linking words.
